title: Deterministic legal-rule suite (PDPA breach notification, Limitation Act 1959, Employment Act salary timing)
description: Seeded Singapore legal-rule cases graded by code oracles, not by a judge model. Families: PDPA notifiable-breach scale/harm limbs and the 3-calendar-day PDPC deadline; Limitation Act 1959 s 6 six-year contract/tort expiry including the Feb 29 roll and last-day boundary; Employment Act salary payment deadline 7 days after salary period end. Every case carries abstention probes and metamorphic twins (cause flip, date shift). Rule parameters and their provenance live in minder_domain_evals/rulebook.py; the limitation and salary rules are marked secondary (re-verify before external reliance). Seeds >= 1000 are the holdout split. The committed fixture is a small dev sample; any (seed, n) regenerates byte-identically via --families legal.

tasks.title: Legal oracles pass themselves, every mutant fails, hand-worked anchors hold (tests/test_domain_evals.py)
Reference answers replay through the grader at 100% on the committed dev sample
Model under test through the minder proxy: python -m minder_domain_evals run --families legal / score; compare reports with minder-op benchmark compare
